newsitem.title: USA: Encore Wire stake cut by Vinik group.
newsitem.headline: Encore Wire stake cut by Vinik group.

text.p: A group led by former Fidelity Magellan Fund manager Jeffrey Vinik said Friday it has reduced its stake in Encore Wire Corp to 6 percent or 425,800 shares from a last reported 7.4 percent or 529,300 shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it sold the shares between June 30 and July 10 at prices ranging from $30.14 to $33.97 each.
Encore, based in McKinney, Texas, manufactures copper electrical wire for commercial industrial and residential use.
